applicabilityBasis.summary: AZND is described as a credit-backed USD token used in DeFi and minted 1:1 against USDC, USDT or AUSD. Terms give eligible registered users a conditional right to redeem for USDC and separate loAZND locking rewards. GENIUS section 2(22)(A)(ii)(I) excludes a digital asset denominated in fixed monetary value from the monetary redemption test. The opened materials do not establish fiat/deposit redemption or an actual fund-share security, so payment-stablecoin applicability remains unresolved.

genius.notes: AZND documentation calls it a credit-backed USD yield token and says users stake to earn yield. The October 2025 Terms of Use identify Bash Bros Inc, cover AZND issued pursuant to those terms, and distinguish AZND from loAZND locking receipts. They provide redemption for USDC subject to account eligibility and other conditions, with processing up to ten business days; the mint/redeem documentation instead describes a weekly fund schedule of approximately seven calendar days. A public stablecoin-swap redemption process exists, but a 1:1 fiat/deposit redemption policy was not established, so redemptionPolicyPresent remains false under the tracker definition. Reserve disclosure is an issuer portfolio description, not a current independently reconciled reserve report or monthly attestation. Terms exclude United States, Singapore and Ontario platform users; these exclusions do not establish a GENIUS authorization or a blanket EU exclusion. The base record marks AZND frozen and in wind-down; the cited X wind-down announcement could not be independently opened in fetch/browser. Legacy documentation may not describe the currently operating redemption process. No qualifying authorization, official application, foreign registration, or named regulator enforcement action was found in the specified public sources and exact-name searches. not-yet-restricted describes statutory GENIUS timing only, not current token availability or issuer eligibility.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No reviewed public source names Bash Bros Inc or AZND as a GENIUS permitted issuer, state-qualified issuer, official applicant or registered foreign issuer. OCC table contains named banking applications but no Mu Digital/Bash Bros entry; NYDFS directory and issuance Greenlist contain no matching entity/token. Treasury SCRC rule concerns procedure and withholds acceptance pending PRA approval and notice, rather than approving any issuer. An unrelated Mu Digital 4 Ventures SEC search result was not treated as an AZND issuer or approval. Findings are bounded to the actual opened sources and searches and do not establish that no unpublished filing exists.
